84bf07de869d3221cc30a613: When everything goes into the global rule, details of one task start influencing unrelated tasks. When everything stays in the prompt, you repeat instructions. Separating roles helps you find the correct place for each correction.

c278be863e7c03e1ffcfea0e: Frequency: how many times it repeats.
e91baabaf8148726dbafe075: Cost of the error: what a failure causes.
